page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c9i.12xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 48 dedicated vCPUs utilizing the x86_64 architecture. The underlying processor is an Intel Xeon 6982P-C running at a clock speed of 3.2 GHz.

The instance is configured with 96.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. It does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, requiring external block storage for operating system and application data. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 25 Gbps.

With a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, this instance type is designed for compute-heavy workloads that require dedicated CPU resources without the overhead of excess memory. This hardware profile provides qualitative cost efficiency for CPU-bound tasks by minimizing memory-related expenses. Suitable workloads include high-performance web serving, batch processing, distributed analytics, and compute-intensive application servers.
